summary.text: Damon Cerreta is an independent candidate for Connecticut's 4th Congressional District.
A Stamford-born business owner, he is running on themes of reducing corporate abuses of consumers and strengthening working-class protections.

paragraphs.text: Cerreta was born in Stamford, Connecticut, and earned a high school diploma from Ridgefield High School.
He has worked as a business owner, including managing a customer service team before starting his own company.
